input: Draft a house-sitting agreement for our vacation

gold.taskTitle: Draft a House-Sitting Agreement for Your Vacation
gold.taskDescription: Create a written house-sitting agreement to be used while the user is away on vacation.

questions.title: Who is the house-sitter — friend, family, or professional?
questions.description: Understand the relationship between the homeowner and the house-sitter to set the appropriate tone and legal formality of the agreement.

questions.title: What are the exact dates of the house-sitting period?
questions.description: Capture the precise start and end dates so the agreement clearly defines the duration of responsibility.

questions.title: Is the house-sitter being paid or doing this for free?
questions.description: Determine whether compensation, free lodging, or another arrangement is involved, as this affects the agreement's terms.

questions.title: Will the house-sitter be caring for pets or plants?
questions.description: Identify specific responsibilities such as feeding pets, watering plants, or other routine care tasks to include in the agreement.

questions.title: Are there rules about guests staying at the property?
questions.description: Clarify whether the house-sitter is allowed to have overnight guests or visitors, which is a common point of conflict.

questions.title: What areas or items in the home are off-limits?
questions.description: Note any restricted rooms, appliances, vehicles, or belongings the house-sitter should not access or use.

questions.title: What country or state governs this agreement legally?
questions.description: Determine the legal jurisdiction so the agreement can reference applicable local laws and be properly enforceable.
